title: Revengeance, Part Triangle

html:
Quest Giver: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Look for Halfassin Black on Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill him and report to [GoS] Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Look for Halfassin Black on Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill him and report to [GoS] Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Halfassin Black got me again! I'm a bit indisposed, and need your help again with my revengeancing. Please go to Level 2 and do you-know-what to you-know-who.

Turn-in:

Hehehe! These two...they make me giggle. Let me know when one or the other gets another kill.

Objectives:

  • Kill Halfassin Black

Level range: 50–60
